copy.tagline: 按照策略练习吉他指弹与扫弦，追踪进步
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在学习原声吉他并能从中获取练习策略
copy.tagline_en: Practice acoustic guitar with strategies for fingerpicking, strumming, and track progress
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are learning acoustic guitar and need structured practice strategies

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会创建专属目录，在你练习吉他时提供指弹、扫弦等技巧指导，练习后主动询问是否记录进度。
howto.when: 当你提到吉他练习、指弹、扫弦等问题，或完成一段练习后，Claude 根据你的水平与目标给出建议。

say.text: 教我一段简单的指弹模式。
我的扫弦听起来很死板，怎么改进？
say.note: Claude会检查手腕动作和力度。

say.text: 帮我记录今天练习的歌曲。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates a dedicated workspace and provides fingerpicking, strumming, and practice strategies for acoustic guitar. After practice, it offers to log progress.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention guitar practice, fingerpicking, strumming, or after completing a practice session. Claude adapts advice based on your style, genre, and goals.

say_en.text: Teach me a simple fingerpicking pattern.
say_en.note: Claude demonstrates Travis picking or arpeggios.

say_en.text: My strumming sounds dull. How to improve?
say_en.note: Claude checks wrist motion and dynamics.
